claim: mosquitto(8) documents a dedicated $SYS counter for the silent-drop mechanism: $SYS/broker/publish/messages/dropped is 'The total number of MQTT PUBLISH messages that have been dropped due to inflight/queuing limits. See the max_inflight_messages and max_queued_messages options in mosquitto.conf(5)'.
stance_target: gap-07: independent confirmation of the max_queued_messages silent-drop mechanism beyond HA #135266, and the concrete $SYS check the D9 fix should ship
scope_conditions: mosquitto 2.1.2 (Debian unstable manpage, mirrors official); $SYS published per sys_interval
quoted_support: $SYS/broker/publish/messages/dropped — The total number of MQTT PUBLISH messages that have been dropped due to inflight/queuing limits. See the max_inflight_messages and max_queued_messages options in mosquitto.conf(5) for more information.

claim: $SYS/broker/load/publish/dropped/{1min,5min,15min} are moving averages of dropped publish messages that 'show the rate at which durable clients that are disconnected are losing messages' — the man page's own framing of the drop mechanism as offline-durable-client message loss.
stance_target: gap-07: the drop mechanism's semantics (offline durable clients lose messages) matches the HA #135266 restart-replay failure mode
quoted_support: This shows the rate at which durable clients that are disconnected are losing messages.

claim: $SYS/broker/store/messages/count (message store: retained + queued-for-durable-clients) diverging upward from $SYS/broker/retained messages/count is the documented pre-drop warning signal: queue depth for offline clients accumulates before drops begin.
stance_target: gap-07 sizing calibration: the $SYS pair gives a live measurement of whether the per-client queue ever approaches max_queued_messages at jupiterOS scale
quoted_support: The number of messages currently held in the message store. This includes retained messages and messages queued for durable clients.
